question: In a certain code language, FEVERISH is coded as 29 and COUNSEL is coded as 98, then how will MUTATED be coded as in the same code language?
solution: The table is alphabets place value: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] The pattern followed here is: **Sum of all alphabets place value and number coded as arranging reverse number.** FEVERISH is coded as 29.
